assets.title: Try one real workflow for free
assets.content:
Subject: Try one real workflow for free
Preview text: Build a customer intake form or survey before deciding if Tally fits.

Build one real intake form for free

Hi there,

Start with one customer-facing intake or survey—the kind of real workflow that tells you more than a product tour. You can build it before deciding whether Tally suits the job.

Tally is an online form builder where you create a form by typing questions as you would in a document. That gives you a concrete way to test the building experience on work that matters.

And the free plan does not stop at that first form. It includes unlimited forms and unlimited submissions as long as your usage stays within Tally’s fair usage guidelines—so separate intake and survey workflows can each have their own form.

The first decision is simply which workflow to try.

Create a free form → https://tally.so/create

- Tally

reader_verdicts.what_it_sells: Tally offers a free online form builder that would let me create customer intake forms and surveys by typing questions in a document-like editor.
reader_verdicts.relevance_feedback: The offer is plausibly relevant to an operations/customer success lead because it addresses customer-facing intake and survey workflows. However, the profile does not establish that I currently need a new form builder, lack one, or plan to replace one, and the email does not claim otherwise.
assumed_experiences: Profile-supported: I lead operations/customer success at a fast-growing company.

Unknown: whether I currently use another form builder or need to change my process.
reader_verdicts.problem_now: Customer intake and survey workflows are relevant to my role, but no current failure, deadline, or active tool search is established. The need to test a new builder today is unknown.
reader_verdicts.stopped_at: And the free plan does not stop at that first form.
reader_verdicts.biggest_doubt: I understand the low-risk offer, but I do not yet see why moving a real workflow into Tally is worth my time compared with whatever process I may already use. The unlimited-plan explanation adds caveats without establishing a concrete advantage I need today.
reader_verdicts.to_click_it_would_have_to: I would have clicked if this email had told me roughly how long it takes to recreate a typical customer intake form and whether I can invite a teammate to test it on the free plan.
fixes: Cut or shorten “And the free plan does not stop at that first form. It includes unlimited forms and unlimited submissions as long as your usage stays within Tally’s fair usage guidelines—so separate intake and survey workflows can each have their own form.” The fair-usage caveat raises a new question before I have a reason to care about unlimited volume.

Rewrite “The first decision is simply which workflow to try.” as “Choose an existing intake form or survey, recreate it in Tally, and test it with your team.” This would make the next step more concrete without implying a full rollout.
Expand “You can build it before deciding whether Tally suits the job.” with a specific setup-time expectation and a clear statement about whether teammate testing is included in the free plan.

allowed_claims: Tally offers unlimited forms and unlimited submissions for free, within fair usage guidelines
Tally lets you accept payments by creating checkout forms without code using Stripe
Tally supports file uploads up to 10MB on the free plan
Tally has an AI tool (Tally AI) that can generate, edit and fix forms in plain language
Tally offers API access to programmatically create, update or delete forms and submissions
Tally Pro costs $29/month or $290/year, cancel anytime
Tally Business costs $89/month or $890/year (2 months off), cancel anytime, and includes access to Tally Pro features
Tally Pro removes the 10MB file size limit on all file uploads
Tally Pro form version history restores form versions up to 30 days, versus 7 days on the free plan
Tally Business lets you automatically delete form submissions after a set period to comply with privacy frameworks
Tally Pro plan costs €20 per month
Tally Business plan costs €65 per month
Tally's free plan offers unlimited forms and unlimited submissions, subject to fair usage guidelines
Pro plan includes removal of Tally branding from forms
Pro plan allows hosting forms on a custom (sub)domain for branded links
Pro plan removes the 10 MB per file size limit on the File Upload block
Pro plan allows restoring a form to a previous version up to 30 days ago
Business plan allows restoring a form to a previous version up to 90 days ago
Business plan can verify respondents' email addresses to improve lead quality and conversions
Tally Pro lets you invite an unlimited number of team members to shared workspaces to share forms and results securely
All users within an organization have the same editing rights to create, edit, view, and delete forms and workspaces
Tally Pro lets you group forms into workspaces and create folders within each workspace, with team members invited and access managed per workspace
Tally offers a free, native Notion integration to send form submissions to Notion databases, not requiring Zapier
The Tally Google Sheets integration automatically sends form submissions directly to Google Sheets in real-time, available free to all Tally users

intelligence.selected_audience: Operations/customer success lead at a fast-growing company
partial_caveats_injected: Pro plan subscription is required for shared workspaces, team invites, branding removal and custom (sub)domain hosting (R1, R3, R5, E16, E17)
Notion integration requires publishing the form and connecting a Notion account (R6)
Google Sheets integration requires a free Google account (R7)
Free-tier use of unlimited forms and submissions stays within the published fair usage guidelines (E1, E15)

Native Notion property coverage excludes Person and Relation properties, Make and Zapier connectors are not established by the selected evidence, and all organization members hold identical create/edit/delete rights apart from two owner-only privileges.
validation_warnings: Publication date unknown; retrieval today does not establish current applicability.
